title: Login methods and two-factor authentication
intro: External identity sources (RADIUS, LDAP, OpenID Connect) and the MFA policy are set under Management › AAA in the configuration. Here you test a backend and manage your own second factor.

error.no-role-mapping: Your identity provider accepted you, but none of your groups is mapped to a role on this device.
error.rate-limited: Too many login attempts; try again in a minute.
error.oidc-unavailable: The identity provider cannot be reached.
error.oidc-failed: Single sign-on failed. Try again or sign in with a password.

step.title: Two-factor authentication
step.enter: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
step.invalid: The code was not accepted. Codes can be used only once; wait for the next one.
step.expired: The sign-in step expired. Sign in again.
step.enrolIntro: Your administrator requires a second factor. Add this key to an authenticator app (TOTP, 6 digits, 30 seconds), then enter the first code.
step.shownOnce: This key is shown only once.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now — store them somewhere safe.

mine.title: My second factor
mine.required: The MFA policy requires it for your role.
mine.activated: Two-factor authentication is on. Your other sessions were signed out.
mine.lost: Lost your authenticator? Use a recovery code at sign-in, or ask an administrator to reset your second factor.

test.title: Test an identity source
test.intro: Checks a user name and password against a configured backend. No session is created; the password is not stored.
test.adminOnly: Only administrators can test identity sources.

reset.confirm: Remove the second factor of {{user}}? Their sessions end; with an MFA policy they set it up again at the next sign-in.

password.title: Set the password of {{user}}
password.keepKeys: Keep this user's API keys (service accounts)
password.endsSessions: The user's sessions end. Their API keys are revoked unless you keep them.
